predeclared.missingness_policy: an operational failure is typed missingness and is never rerun in place; eligibility requires operational failures under 10% of planned cells (7 of 72)
predeclared.primary: admission rate over worlds (a cell is admitted when the stack executes, every constraint check holds and financing funds), with a world-clustered bootstrap interval
predeclared.secondary: mean developer_equity_npv delta from the scripted reference over admitted cells, world-clustered bootstrap
predeclared.seed_handling: the three seeds of a world are averaged within the world before worlds are treated as independent

reading: one route, descriptive: the interval is a world-clustered bootstrap over 24 fresh held-out worlds at developer interface 3 with the three seeds averaged inside each world first, one seeded stream serving the admission and then the delta interval. The predeclared harness check passed: 0 of 72 cells died at the amendment phase. 66 of 72 declined the amendment and site control expired before commercial operation in 46 of the 49 stacks the lender would not fund, which is the developer's error and is scored as completed_but_unfinanced, not a harness finding. Five walks stated their reason and are valid walks, four of them refusing a written advance rate the lender's message had disavowed. Comparison to the first confirmatory (admission 0.25 on a different held-out pack under interface 2) is descriptive only; no winner, ranking or causal claim
